name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2012 (Data for Calendar Year 2011)
description:
This dataset contains energy and water use disclosures for New York City buildings under Local Law 84, covering calendar year 2011. Each row represents a single building and includes its address, borough, building identifiers, year built, floor area, and facility type, along with energy benchmarking results such as Energy Star ratings, site energy intensity, weather-normalized energy use, greenhouse gas emissions, and renewable energy purchases. It also breaks down consumption by fuel type (electricity, natural gas, district steam, fuel oils, chilled water) and reports indoor, outdoor, and total water use. Many columns capture space-specific details for property types like offices, hotels, hospitals, schools, multifamily housing, retail, warehouses, and data centers, such as occupancy, operating hours, equipment counts, and floor area by use.

The data can be used to compare building energy and water performance across property types and neighborhoods, identify high-intensity or high-emission buildings, track benchmarking participation and Energy Star labeling, and study
